text.en:
Section four of Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred and eighty-six is hereby amended to read
"Section 4. The Executive Secretary shall prepare and sub-Legislature, on the first day of each regular session,
a draft of a general appropriation bill on the basis of the data so secured, in English and in Spanish, furnishing
to each House twenty-five copies thereof in each of said languages."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 3, 1915.
